wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 42276662 is the 19-vertex main manor footprint south of the farm courtyard. The projection toward the garden and end gables match the museum conservator’s description and the cleared photos.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the long timber range, garden gable and two unequal towers. Close levels refine open lookout bracing, glazing and entry steps.
limitations: The modern mapped perimeter represents the historic envelope evident in the cleared 2006 and 2009 photos. Roof heights, timber braces, window details, threshold and foundation exposure are approximate.

The original provider terrain is unchanged. Modern relief slopes east to west around the building. The model represents the main manor before the 2015 fire. The detached museum ranges, formal gardens and interiors are outside scope.
